title: Food
subtitle: Elimination diet & ingredient reactions log
description: As I have been experiencing stomach and digestive issues for some time now, my diet is quite strict and I am following an Elimination Diet.
Below you will find the list of ingredients that I have tested so far and how my body reacted to each. I have also documented the specific way I prepared each ingredient and what works best for me.

generalRules.title: Minimal Seasoning
generalRules.description: Only pure sea salt is used. No black or red pepper, paprika, onion/garlic powder, bouillon cubes, or processed spice blends.

generalRules.title: Gentle Cooking Methods
generalRules.description: Boiling in water/broths, steaming, moderate oven-baking (often wrapped in baking paper to lock in moisture), and light stewing. Strictly no deep-frying or charred/burnt crusts.

generalRules.title: Peeled & Deseeded
generalRules.description: Vegetables and fruits are thoroughly peeled and seeds removed to eliminate harsh insoluble fiber that irritates the gut lining.

generalRules.title: Controlled Healthy Fats
generalRules.description: Only extra virgin olive oil (often drizzled over warm food after cooking) or ghee (clarified butter). Strictly no refined industrial seed oils (sunflower, corn, canola).

generalRules.title: Freshness First
generalRules.description: Food is prepared fresh for each meal or frozen immediately after cooking. Extended refrigeration is avoided to keep histamine and bacterial levels minimal.
